scope: Targeted primary literature on costly private information, strategic social learning, information access in complex tasks, selective evidence preservation, optimal evidence stopping, and distinguishing observation noise from environmental change.
relationship_to_v4: This ledger adds eleven targeted sources. Cascade dependence, adviser trust, cultural conservatism, developmental schedules, age structure, and belief-rigidity anchors are reused from v4/evidence/literature_sources.json rather than duplicated in full.
verification_methods: Crossref works API for DOI titles and publication metadata
PubMed and PMC for indexed dates, abstracts, and open full text
publisher article pages and official journal full texts
author and institutional repository manuscripts when publisher full text was restricted

targeted_sources.title: Does Biology Constrain Culture?
targeted_sources.source_backed_mechanism: Individual and social learning strategies compete under environmental variation; social learners draw on information generated by individual learners.
targeted_sources.source_backed_finding: Social learning can evolve without increasing equilibrium mean population fitness, so strategy success and adaptive culture are not equivalent.
targeted_sources.v5_connection: Requires separate reporting of invasion or competition, homogeneous abundance, and population performance.
targeted_sources.critical_boundary: The model is deliberately simple and does not contain retained confidence, adult stages, or learner-visible source quality.

targeted_sources.title: Critical Social Learning: A Solution to Rogers's Paradox of Nonadaptive Culture
targeted_sources.source_backed_mechanism: A critical social learner tries social learning first and switches to individual learning if the socially acquired solution is unsatisfactory.
targeted_sources.source_backed_finding: Critical social learning outperforms pure social learning and is often superior to pure individual learning, except under boundaries including highly unfaithful transmission, high environmental variability, or relatively costly social learning.
targeted_sources.v5_connection: Closest existing mechanism to social acquisition followed by confidence-based checking; V5 must add a distinct cultural-demographic result.
targeted_sources.critical_boundary: Evaluation of whether a solution is satisfactory is available in the model; V5 learners do not necessarily receive equivalent truth feedback.

targeted_sources.title: Applying evolutionary models to the laboratory study of social learning
targeted_sources.study_type: laboratory microsociety experiments guided by evolutionary models
targeted_sources.source_backed_mechanism: Learners combine social and individual information under manipulated task difficulty and environmental payoff fluctuation.
targeted_sources.source_backed_finding: The study tests the prediction that reliance on social information should rise with task difficulty and fall with environmental change, supporting conditional rather than indiscriminate social learning.
targeted_sources.v5_connection: Motivates the access-by-volatility factorial and the competent retained-private control.
targeted_sources.critical_boundary: Task difficulty was behaviorally instantiated; dividing cue rates by D is not the same mechanism.

targeted_sources.title: Why Copy Others? Insights from the Social Learning Strategies Tournament
targeted_sources.source_backed_mechanism: Agents allocate equal-duration moves among asocial innovation, noisy observation of performed behaviors, and payoff-generating exploitation in a changing environment.
targeted_sources.source_backed_finding: Strategies relying heavily on observation performed well even without a structural asocial-learning cost because observed performers filtered the repertoire by exploiting their best-known behavior; removing that filtering made social learning perform poorly.
targeted_sources.v5_connection: Separates access, social cue noise, behavioral filtering, learning timing, and invasion from monomorphic mean fitness.
targeted_sources.critical_boundary: Adult sign(b) in V5 is not a sampled best-of-repertoire behavior, so the tournament's filtering advantage cannot be assumed.

targeted_sources.title: The evolutionary basis of human social learning
targeted_sources.journal: Proceedings of the Royal Society B: Biological Sciences
targeted_sources.source_backed_mechanism: People arbitrate among social and asocial information using learner confidence, demonstrator consensus and performance, task difficulty, experience, and asocial-learning cost.
targeted_sources.source_backed_finding: All of these factors influenced social-information use in the adaptively predicted directions across the reported tasks.
targeted_sources.v5_connection: Provides an empirical benchmark for uncertainty- and cost-sensitive deference rather than a uniform fixed copying probability.
targeted_sources.critical_boundary: The experiments do not establish that adult status is itself an accuracy cue or that a single parameter should control belief acquisition and action choice.

targeted_sources.title: Sociality influences cultural complexity
targeted_sources.journal: Proceedings of the Royal Society B: Biological Sciences
targeted_sources.source_backed_mechanism: Learners received access to one or five models on structured image-editing and expert-seeded knot-tying tasks.
targeted_sources.source_backed_finding: Five-model access supported image-skill improvement and slowed the loss of expert knot-tying skill relative to one-model access.
targeted_sources.v5_connection: Positive empirical link between multi-model access and the accumulation or maintenance of difficult skills.
targeted_sources.critical_boundary: Participants observed structured artifacts and could integrate across models; V5 has a single exchangeable binary task and sign-only testimony.

targeted_sources.title: Increasing population size can inhibit cumulative cultural evolution
targeted_sources.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
targeted_sources.source_backed_mechanism: Paper-plane learners observed one, two, or four prior-generation models under controlled viewing time per artifact, without being able to avoid poorer artifacts through selective filtering.
targeted_sources.source_backed_finding: Larger model sets did not enhance cumulative plane performance; the strongest improvements appeared in the smallest social condition, despite larger sets generating access to variation and good variants.
targeted_sources.v5_connection: Mandatory counterexample to monotone benefits from more social information or more models.
targeted_sources.critical_boundary: The result is task- and information-selection-dependent and does not show that population size is generally harmful.

targeted_sources.title: The Cost of Accumulating Evidence in Perceptual Decision Making
targeted_sources.study_type: normative decision model fitted to monkey and human perceptual decisions
targeted_sources.source_backed_mechanism: Diffusion evidence accumulation is combined with dynamic programming to infer the cost of additional observations from reaction-time and accuracy behavior.
targeted_sources.source_backed_finding: Estimated observation cost was neither zero nor constant; it included an initially near-constant period followed by increasing cost, and the model captured time-dependent decisions.
targeted_sources.v5_connection: Provides a normative standard for distinguishing value-of-information stopping from an imposed no-query policy.
targeted_sources.critical_boundary: A reaction-time perceptual task does not identify the biological mortality cost or adult life-history objective in V5.

targeted_sources.title: An Approximately Bayesian Delta-Rule Model Explains the Dynamics of Belief Updating in a Changing Environment
targeted_sources.study_type: human change-point experiment and approximate Bayesian model
targeted_sources.source_backed_mechanism: Prediction-error influence is adaptively scaled by relative uncertainty and the inferred probability of a change point in the generative process.
targeted_sources.source_backed_finding: Participants gave unexpectedly large outcomes more influence when those outcomes suggested a fundamental environmental change rather than persistent stochasticity, with substantial individual variation.
targeted_sources.v5_connection: Direct benchmark for reopening or increasing learning after evidence diagnostic of change.
targeted_sources.critical_boundary: The distinction requires an assumed generative model and hazard prior; identical observation likelihoods provide no causal identification.

targeted_sources.title: Normative evidence accumulation in unpredictable environments
targeted_sources.study_type: normative evidence-accumulation theory and human perceptual experiments
targeted_sources.source_backed_mechanism: Expected environmental hazard produces leaky evidence accumulation with non-absorbing bounds, balancing signal integration against change detection.
targeted_sources.source_backed_finding: Participants learned environmental expectations imperfectly and adjusted decision dynamics in the direction predicted by the normative model.
targeted_sources.v5_connection: Motivates hazard-dependent decay or auditing as a comparator to permanently retained confidence.
targeted_sources.critical_boundary: The task assumes a known class of dynamic generative processes and does not contain intergenerational testimony or demographic selection.

targeted_sources.title: Correcting false information in memory: Manipulating the strength of misinformation encoding and its retraction
targeted_sources.source_backed_mechanism: Misinformation encoding strength and later retraction strength were manipulated by repetition and cognitive load to test continued influence on memory and reasoning.
targeted_sources.source_backed_finding: Stronger corrections reduced continued influence associated with strongly encoded misinformation, but correction did not uniformly eliminate continued influence.
targeted_sources.v5_connection: Motivates measuring persistence and recovery after a temporarily misleading evidence interval.
targeted_sources.critical_boundary: Narrative misinformation with an explicit retraction is not equivalent to an unlabeled binary cue channel; the study does not establish universal dogmatism.

reused_v4_anchors.mechanism_reused: Observed actions can be correlated and cease to reveal independent private signals during an informational cascade.
reused_v4_anchors.v5_use: Repeated adult signs must not automatically be interpreted as independent evidence.

reused_v4_anchors.mechanism_reused: Learners update adviser fidelity and volatility using prediction-error-like computations.
reused_v4_anchors.v5_use: Experience-dependent trust is an established alternative to fixed deference.

reused_v4_anchors.mechanism_reused: The strength of disconfirming social opinions was underused relative to confirming opinions.
reused_v4_anchors.v5_use: A genuine confirmation test requires agreement-dependent weighting, which the symmetric V5 score does not implement.

reused_v4_anchors.mechanism_reused: Participants generally updated toward empirical evidence across four studies, including belief-incongruent evidence.
reused_v4_anchors.v5_use: Limits any claim that belief perseverance or dogmatism is a default empirical pattern.

reused_v4_anchors.mechanism_reused: Cultural transmission can generate conservatism and persuasion dynamics.
reused_v4_anchors.v5_use: An imposed frozen architecture is not a novel endogenous rigidity mechanism.

reused_v4_anchors.mechanism_reused: Development and repertoire acquisition can alter openness over the life course.
reused_v4_anchors.v5_use: Retained confidence and developmental closing are established mechanism classes.

identification_warnings.warning: The prose contract's same d governs testimony acceptance into persistent b and action override, so a pooled d effect does not identify which channel is causal.
identification_warnings.required_test: Addressed in the current experiment design by independent accept, override, and conflict_only flags plus a predeclared 2x2 ablation; results must remain disaggregated.

identification_warnings.warning: Dividing private and social encounter rates by D creates evidence scarcity or repertoire dilution, not task complexity.
identification_warnings.required_test: Use calibrated terminology; a true complexity extension needs represented subskills, dependencies, or recombination.

identification_warnings.warning: Frozen adults query less and therefore pay less c_query, confounding preserved accuracy with sampling savings.
An imposed no-query policy is not an evolved or normative stopping rule and does not establish dogmatism.
identification_warnings.required_test: Compare with confidence audit and a value-of-information or matched-budget policy.

identification_warnings.warning: Identical learner-observed cue and cost histories produce identical cognitive trajectories when transition rules have no truth access.
identification_warnings.required_test: Paired histories should match state by state; add learner-visible source metadata or truth feedback only in a separately labeled identifiable model.

identification_warnings.warning: Adult testimony can share cultural ancestry, so encounter count is not effective independent sample size.
identification_warnings.required_test: Track or approximate source-lineage correlation before interpreting consensus.

ranked_model_tests.test: Report the predeclared accept-by-override 2x2 ablation and conflict-only storage without pooling the channels.
ranked_model_tests.reason: The current implementation resolves the primary causal underidentification in d only if the ablation remains explicit in analysis.

ranked_model_tests.test: Separate accuracy from sampling savings with zero-cost and equal-budget controls.
ranked_model_tests.reason: Determines whether freezing preserves useful knowledge or merely avoids query mortality.

ranked_model_tests.test: Pair unchanged-truth and reversed-truth runs using identical observed cue histories with truth-linked filtering disabled.
ranked_model_tests.reason: Validates the H4 observational-equivalence invariant and detects unintended truth leakage.

ranked_model_tests.test: Seed correct, neutral, and wrong adult culture and measure recovery.
ranked_model_tests.reason: Tests whether the claimed benefit depends on favorable inherited culture.

ranked_model_tests.test: Compare homogeneous outcomes with rare-mutant growth and reduce effective sample size for shared lineage.
ranked_model_tests.reason: Addresses frequency dependence, Rogers-style divergence, and correlated social evidence.

candidate_contribution_status.defensible_if: A coupled cultural-demographic result survives retained-private, channel-splitting, zero-cost, wrong-culture, environmental-reversal, and invasion controls.
not_currently_supported: a new general mechanism of social learning
an evolved or normatively optimal theory of dogmatism
learner-side identification of misinformation versus environmental change
a general superiority of adult conviction over competent retained private judgment
